context: Existing snapshot, rerun and forced rebuild

checklist.name: Plain run stops
checklist.description: Stops at the prerequisite guard with the message that the ctx folder exists and --force is needed, and changes no file

checklist.name: Forced run rescans
checklist.description: With --force, rescans the in-folder and asks for priorities again instead of reusing the old manifest

checklist.name: Rewrites all artefacts
checklist.description: Rewrites the manifest, copies, summaries and baseline together so they stay consistent

checklist.name: Warns about edits
checklist.description: Warns that hand-edited summaries are discarded and suggests saving any worth keeping first

checklist.name: No concurrent run
checklist.description: Does not start while a save-context or load-context run is writing to the same folder
